explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
Violation of God's will and law, characterized by injustice and betrayal as described throughout the chapter.
God's attribute of judging fairly and His requirement that people act rightly.
God's loving grace and willingness to forgive, emphasized at the end of the chapter.
Firm faith in God's salvation and protection even in difficult times.
God's actions to save His people from enemies and sin.
The positive expectation that God will remain faithful to His promises.
